description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [High Quick Cast 1], [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Lotus] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lotus
description.text: White Magic and Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic and Support abilities, casts Superior Light after using a White Magic and Support ability

description.name: Superior Light
description.text: Restores HP (10/15/25/35/45) at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
